errors.evidence: The pie chart contains four sectors, not five.
The chart does not contain a category named "Други" (Others).

errors.text_span: Секторът „Клиент/Възложител“ заема най-голям дял, представлявайки приблизително 47.6% от общия брой отговори.
errors.evidence: The "Клиент/Възложител" sector represents 14.3%, not 47.6%. The largest share (47.6%) belongs to the "Строител" sector.

errors.text_span: Следващият по големина сектор е „Строител“, който обхваща около 33.3% от анкетираните.
errors.evidence: The "Строител" sector represents 47.6%, not 33.3%. The 33.3% share belongs to the "Проектант" sector.
The "Проектант" sector represents 33.3%, not 14.3%. The 14.3% share belongs to the "Клиент/Възложител" sector.
The "Консултант/Надзор" slice does not have a percentage label in the chart. Based on the other values, its share is approximately 4.8% (100 - 47.6 - 33.3 - 14.3). The value 11.8% is incorrect.
The description fails to mention that the "Консултант/Надзор" slice does not have a percentage value label on it, which is a significant feature of the data visualization.

errors.text_span: и включва кратко описание на правилното разбиране
errors.evidence: This phrase, which translates to 'and includes a short description for proper understanding', inaccurately and vaguely describes the legend. The legend simply lists the names of the categories.
